messages:
emily-docs: Pushed a docs PR with a new paragraph about SOC2 audit-log retention and an SDK redaction example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1999. Can legal & security eyeball the deletion wording?

raj-security: quick heads-up: don't promise absolute deletion. Also mention encrypted exports and link KMS page.

noor-legal: Agreed. Suggest we use a soft wording: "Deleted items are removed from active audit stores and marked for overwrite; copies in immutable backups or customer-managed exports may persist beyond the retention window."

emily-docs: That reads well. I'll replace any 'permanently deleted' lines. Also added an SDK snippet that shows delete vs redact; want to include a clarifying comment. Example I added:

```python
# asynchronous mark-for-deletion
client.audit.delete_event("evt_123")
# request targeted redaction for export artifacts
client.audit.redact_event("evt_123", scope="exports")
```

noor-legal: Include a clear label: "redact_event may trigger background workflows; immediate removal from third-party backups cannot be guaranteed."

sam-support: tiny operational note: if customers need stronger guarantees, recommend Dedicated/Private deployments  - support can open a case to disable export hooks.

raj-security: also swap 'pseudonymization' phrasing: use 'tokenization or provably irreversible pseudonymization' depending on the technique. And add KMS/HSM link next to 'encrypted exports'.

emily-docs: I'll make these edits and push. Will also add a 1-line troubleshooting FAQ below the snippet. Thanks.

docs-bot: PR updated by emily-docs : https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1999/files - reviewers: raj-security, noor-legal, sam-support

emily-docs: pushed changes. PTAL.

noor-legal: LGTM from legal after tiny punctuation tweak.

raj-security: LGTM from sec after adding KMS link.

sam-support: LGTM - added a support playbook link in the PR comments.

emily-docs: merging in 15m if no objections. :shipit:
